name: config_listen
description: Listen / read configurations from z-config center. Use this when the CEO agent (or a service) starts up and needs to load its required configurations. Returns the current value of a config (by key + group + namespace) or lists all configs in a namespace. Configs can be application settings, feature flags, environment-specific URLs, etc. Backed by GET /api/config/listConfig, /api/config/getConfig, /api/config/namespaceList. Requires z-ctc 'config:read' permission.

key.description: Specific config key. If provided, returns just this config value. If omitted, returns list.

listAll.description: If true, return all configs in the namespace (not just one key). Default false.
